content.intro: Learn cookies and browser state through a compact visual, an inspectable Django example, and a practical verification task.
content.why_it_matters: Cookies and Browser State matters because a Django project has to behave predictably across requests, database state, configuration, and deployments. Understanding this piece makes the surrounding application easier to test, maintain, and secure.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: This lesson examines cookies and browser state as part of middleware, cookies, sessions, and messaging. The objective is to understand the behavior, connect it to the listed subtopics, and verify it with a small example rather than relying on memorized syntax.
